utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: Will the registrar call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is case number IT-02-58-PT, the Prosecutor versus Ljubisa Beara.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: Can I take the appearances. Who appears for the Prosecutor?

utterances.speaker: MS. ISSA
utterances.text: May it please the Court. Good afternoon, Your Honour. It's Antoinette Issa on behalf of the Prosecution, along with my colleague, Ms. Stewart.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: Thank you, Ms. Issa. For the Accused?

utterances.speaker: MR. OSTOJIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. John Stojic on behalf of the accused, Mr. Beara.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Ostojic. Now I can confirm that we have one matter on hand at the moment and that is the proposed amendment of the indictment. I issued an order in that regard at the end of last week. I understand that Mr. Ostojic drew nothing to say on the matter, and therefore when the Prosecution reply to me, I will be in a position to deal with that, and I plan to deal with that fairly expeditiously. Now, Ms. Issa, are there any issues that you wish to raise today?

utterances.speaker: MS. ISSA
utterances.text: None today, Your Honour, thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: Mr. Ostojic, any issues you wish to raise with me?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: Are there any matters that your client has drawn to your attention that you wish to address me on.

utterances.speaker: MR. OSTOJIC
utterances.text: None at this time, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Ostojic. Well, it seems to me that that concludes the business that we have to deal with at this Status Conference, except to fix the date of the next one. Can I have some guidance on that, please?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: The deadline for the next Status Conference is the 15th of June. That happens to be a Wednesday. It's as good a day as any, so we shall have the next Status Conference on Wednesday, the 15th of June, at 3.00 p.m., unless you're advised to the contrary. We are adjourned.

procedural_notes.text: [Pre-trial Judge and the legal officer confer]
--- Whereupon the Status Conference adjourned at
